agents.verdict: Use concrete scenes as evidence, not repeated props.
agents.recommendation: Use one small repair gesture and wide negative space; keep props minimal and make the changing distance the evidence.

agents.verdict: Keep the romance scene on the unspoken emotional request.
agents.recommendation: Stage the tension as pride versus repair: Aachu does not say the perfect sorry, but her care returns first.

agents.verdict: Approve only if the plan avoids one-setting repetition and keeps Zuv active.
agents.recommendation: Block crowded domestic setups, too many apology props, and any frame where Zuv laughs at her instead of receiving the repair.

options.name: One Gesture, Wide Silence
options.case_for: Makes the apology visible through one small care action while preserving lots of negative space.
options.risk: Needs restraint so the collar does not become a prop-first premise.

options.name: Distance Gets Smaller
options.case_for: Uses spacing as the visual story: after the fight, the figures gradually share the frame again.
options.risk: Can become too subtle if the repair gesture is not unmistakable.

options.name: Proud Return
options.case_for: Strong Aachu body-language lane: chin-up, attitude, but returning.
options.risk: Can over-index on attitude unless Zuv's gentle reception is clearly active.

selector_verdict: One Gesture, Wide Silence wins because it turns the unsaid apology into a drawable care gesture while protecting the airy, uncrowded visual style.
hard_fails_checked: no repeated object motif across every slide

final_visual_plan.visual: A spacious warm-paper relationship hook: Aachu stands a little turned away after a tiny fight, expressive but soft, while Zuv stands nearby with calm open posture; the background is almost empty, just one simple doorway line and lots of breathing room.

Aachu comes back into the frame with chin-up attitude and one hand adjusting her dupatta or sleeve, clearly returning without saying the perfect word; Zuv stays still and receptive, giving the moment space.
Close, simple proof beat with only their upper bodies: Aachu is still pretending to be annoyed while gently fixing Zuv's collar with careful fingers; Zuv keeps a soft face and does not tease her.

final_visual_plan.copy: And he knows not to laugh.
final_visual_plan.visual: Zuv looks down with the smallest controlled smile, choosing not to laugh because he understands this is her repair language; Aachu's body is close but proud, the scene uncluttered and tender.
Final airy couple frame: the distance between them has closed, one small collar/dupatta detail remains as the receipt, and the warm off-white space around them carries the quiet apology.
